# ChatGPT Prompts Library

> > A comprehensive prompt library for AI image generation with ChatGPT, DALL-E 3, Midjourney, and Flux, specializing in photography, art styles, and marketing applications.

ChatGPT Prompts Library provides ready-to-use prompt templates for generating high-quality images across multiple AI platforms including DALL-E 3, Midjourney v7, and Flux 1.1 Pro. The library covers diverse categories from product photography and architectural visualization to artistic styles like ukiyo-e and steampunk, with specialized guides for e-commerce and marketing professionals.

## Key Topics

- ChatGPT
- DALL-E 3
- Midjourney v7
- Flux 1.1 Pro
- AI image generation
- Prompt engineering
- Product photography
- 4K image quality
- E-commerce (Amazon, Shopify)
- Marketing & SEO
- Photography prompts
- Art style generation
- Prompt templates
- AI art generation
